titleEn: Practice and Powers (Shentong)
snippetEn: Speaking of cultivation — in truth what many yearn for is the so-called powers. Why do powers arise in cultivation? Powers are simply an ability; their conditions of origin are many and various: some opened by self-power cultivation reaching a certain realm, some by specially tinkering with function through certain methods, some opened by possession, some opened by external force — in sum, none beyond these kinds. Why powers — that is, functions — arise: on this point, readers may take it as some original human capacities being unlocked; everyone has them in fact, only activated after cultivating to a certain degree. Function, for a cultivator, is wholly a by-product on the road of seeking long life; hidden sects, or schools that know certain things, often warn disciples that even with abilities they will not use them — strict ones even briefly seal them — lest certain consequences come; only after a kind of self-sufficiency may they be used.

title: 道无鬼神是什么意思
snippet: 内经云：若夫法天则地，随应而动，和之者若响，随之者若影。道无鬼神，独来独往。就是说，如果取法天地间的道理，根据这些道理，顺着相应变化去做事，那么就跟声响相和，形影相随一样顺利。道不是什么鬼神玄虚的东西，他是独立运行而无止
titleEn: What Does “The Dao Has No Ghosts or Gods” Mean?
snippetEn: The Inner Canon says: “If one takes heaven as model and earth as rule, moving in accord with responses, those harmonizing follow like echo, those following follow like shadow. The Dao has no ghosts or gods; it comes and goes alone.” That is: if one takes the principles between heaven and earth as model and, per these principles, acts along with corresponding changes, then all goes as smoothly as sound matching echo, form matching shadow. The Dao is not some ghost-god mystery; it runs independently without end.

title: 道家三观，是什么东西

titleEn: What Are the Daoist “Three Views”?
snippetEn: The Daoist three views matter greatly: the Daoist view of life, of the world, of values — they must be upright; with the three views not upright, nothing works. One is the method of congealing spirit into the qi-cavern: when enough post-heaven essence-qi has accumulated, at the same time, by congealing spirit into the qi-cavern, gradually open the gate of mystery, communicating with the realm of voidness — the prenatal qi comes from within it.

title: 关于停息和胎息
snippet: 呼吸停止，就是胎息。胎息概念是从胎儿呼吸那里来的，胎儿并不用肺呼吸，他所需要的氧气来自脐带，胎儿是用肚脐呼吸的。而胎息就是玄关呼吸，玄关呼吸并不是呼吸空气，而是呼吸精气。还有一种胎息是身体呼吸，体呼吸是呼吸外界氧气的，只
titleEn: About Breath-Cessation and Fetal Breathing
snippetEn: Breath stopping — that is fetal breathing. The concept of fetal breathing comes from the fetus’s breathing: the fetus does not breathe with lungs; its needed oxygen comes from the umbilical cord — the fetus breathes with the navel. Fetal breathing is gate-of-mystery breathing; gate-of-mystery breathing does not breathe air but breathes essence-qi. Another kind of fetal breathing is body breathing: body breathing breathes the outside world’s oxygen — only not with mouth and nose, but with the body and skin. Strictly speaking, gate-of-mystery breathing is the true fetal breathing.

title: 胎息和辟谷是要先天境界才能做到么？
snippet: 是，胎息和辟谷其实是境界。
titleEn: Can Fetal Breathing and Bigu Be Done Only in the Prenatal Realm?
snippetEn: Yes — fetal breathing and bigu are in fact realms.

title: 什么是道心？
snippet: 这个东西对我个人来说没有固定答案，甚至可能各家某些标准都不一样，对我来说，道心：态度、境界、对待都可以认为。
titleEn: What Is the Dao-Heart?
snippetEn: For me personally this thing has no fixed answer; the standards of different schools may even differ. For me, dao-heart: attitude, realm, bearing — all can be considered it.

title: 你修炼，为何不顶礼膜拜神、佛，你这是不敬！
snippet: 修炼就要膜拜那种玩意？
titleEn: You Cultivate, Yet You Do Not Bow and Worship Gods and Buddhas — This Is Disrespect!
snippetEn: Cultivation means bowing to that sort of thing?

title: 我有某某功感是怎么回事
snippet: 功感又如何？你想说什么？联想自己天资xx？联想所谓的什么神佛？
titleEn: What About This or That Gong-Sensation I Have?
snippetEn: So what of gong-sensation? What are you trying to get at? Associating your own talent xx? Associating some so-called gods and buddhas?

title: 我要不要劝人修行
snippet: 用不着、没必要
titleEn: Ought I to Persuade People to Cultivate?
snippetEn: Unnecessary; no need.

title: 几个名词解释
snippet: 生发。于后天，是利用某种方法或功法，提高了体内食物、呼吸及其他未知方式所得能量的利用率，转化为气血，再积累为精气。于先天，是通过开玄关、采药，得到先天之气。
titleEn: A Few Terms Explained
snippetEn: Generating. In the post-heaven: using some method or practice to raise the utilization rate of the energy gained from food, breath, and other unknown ways within the body, converting it into qi and blood, then accumulating it into essence-qi. In the prenatal: through opening the gate of mystery and gathering the medicine, obtaining prenatal qi.

title: 为什么很多人练功反而不举？
snippet: 因为没有真东西练错了呗，就不用说其他的了，出事不是早晚的么？
titleEn: Why Do Many, Practicing Gong, Become Impotent Instead?
snippetEn: Because there is no real thing and they practiced wrongly, obviously — need we say more? Is trouble just a matter of sooner or later?

title: 关于内景与幻境
snippet: 一般人不用担心，因为没有东西进不去，连门都没有，就别谈以后，当然可能有鬼神种子、附体啊什么的，可能偶尔会发生一些，但是一般人没有能力辨认。
titleEn: About Inner Scenes and Illusion-Realm
snippetEn: Ordinary people need not worry — because with nothing inside, one cannot even get in; there is not even a door, let alone talk of later. Of course, there may be ghost-god seeds, possession and such; occasionally things may happen, but ordinary people have no ability to distinguish.

title: 先修后证还是先证后修？
snippet: 这俩是一起的，跟走路一样，两脚配合，谁过度都会出问题。
titleEn: Cultivate First Then Verify, or Verify First Then Cultivate?
snippetEn: These two go together, like walking — two feet coordinating; whichever overdoes causes problems.

title: 再谈修证悟
snippet: 人人都谈悟道，先看看自己有没有悟道的资格吧。什么人也有资格悟道的么？证悟证悟，悟还在证之后，没有证，哪有悟的资格。要谈明理悟道，首先得明白，修证悟是一体的，缺了哪一样，都不对。他的顺序是修证悟，而不是悟证修。想先悟道，再
titleEn: More on Cultivation, Verification and Awakening
snippetEn: Everyone talks of awakening to the Dao — first look at whether you are even qualified. Does just anyone qualify to awaken to the Dao?

title: 修炼的坚持
snippet: 修炼之中，坚持是最基本的东西，这个个人而言，没有这项品质还是不要碰的好，没有未来。
titleEn: Perseverance in Cultivation
snippetEn: In cultivation, perseverance is the most basic thing; personally, without this quality one had best not touch it — there is no future.

title: 如何对待先贤
snippet: 先贤，尊敬是本能第一要务，自己品
titleEn: How Should One Treat the Sages of Former Times?
snippetEn: The sages of former times — respect is the first and most instinctive duty; judge for yourself.

title: 修炼之中的聪明人
snippet: 自古以来就不缺各种聪明人，宏观来说分两种。一是有传承的，二是没有传承的。
titleEn: Clever People in Cultivation
snippetEn: Since ancient times there has been no lack of clever people; broadly, two kinds: one with transmission, one without.

title: 关于命要师传和性需自悟
snippet: 大家都说命要师传性需自悟，这句话是什么意思呢？命功固然需要师传，是不是性功就不需要师传，完全靠自己参悟就可以呢？不是的，性功同样需要师传。命要师传性需自悟，指的是说，命功只要师传以后，按照师父所讲按部就班的练下去就好，而
titleEn: On “Life-Work Needs a Master’s Transmission, Nature-Work Needs Self-Awakening”
snippetEn: Everyone says “life-work needs the master’s transmission, nature-work needs self-awakening” — what does this mean? Life-work certainly needs the master’s transmission; does nature-work then not need it, fully relying on one’s own contemplation? No — nature-work equally needs the master’s transmission.

title: 性命功夫能互相促进吗？
snippet: 有很多人，抓住“性住气自回”一句话奉为圭臬，以为修性就是修命，不用修命也是修命。这就是不知阴阳，不懂平衡的缘故。在一定程度内，无论修性还是修命，性命功夫确实是能够互相带动、互相促进的，若一方过于强过另一方，身神失衡甚至严
titleEn: Can Nature-Work and Life-Work Promote Each Other?
snippetEn: Many seize on the line “when nature settles, qi returns of itself” as their golden rule, thinking that cultivating nature is cultivating life — that not cultivating life is also cultivating life.

title: 修炼中，功感是什么样的？为什么文件没有仔细描述功感？
snippet: 功感没有什么百分百什么样，可能每个人都不一样，可能每个人都有相同的莫样，一味的追求功感其实是走偏，其次，并且有专门交流的地方，怎么会流传出来了？
titleEn: In Cultivation, What Is Gong-Sensation Like? Why Do the Documents Not Describe Gong-Sensation Carefully?
snippetEn: Gong-sensation has no hundred-percent form; perhaps everyone differs, perhaps everyone has the same look. Pursuing gong-sensation one-sidedly is in fact deviation. Second, there are places dedicated to exchanging on it — how would it have spread out?

title: 意识才是最重要的？
snippet: 物质和意识一定是不同的吗？？一定是两种东西吗？？万事万物不离阴阳，物质的极点是意识，意识的极点是物质，两者乃是阴阳相抱的，只修意识，孤阴不生。性命双修，才能身神无离，神形俱妙。要修到地仙，乃至超脱这个天地，对于物质的理解
titleEn: Is Consciousness What Matters Most?
snippetEn: Are matter and consciousness necessarily different?? Necessarily two things?? All things do not leave yin and yang: the pole of matter is consciousness, the pole of consciousness is matter; the two are the embrace of yin and yang — to cultivate consciousness alone, the solitary yin does not grow.

title: 古法要通大小周天吗？有炼精化气炼气化神吗？
snippet: 大小周天是清朝伍柳派提出的概念，炼己筑基、炼精化炁、炼炁化神、炼神还虚、炼虚合道这种阶段划分是明朝提出清朝完善的。就算这些都是总结的前人经验加以汇总，那也是内丹法里的，唐宋以后才有内丹法，古仙法怎么会有这些东西呢？当然开
titleEn: Do the Ancient Methods Need to Open the Small and Great Heavenly Circuits? Do They Have Refining Essence into Qi, Refining Qi into Spirit?
snippetEn: The small and great heavenly circuits are concepts put forward by the Wu-Liu school of the Qing dynasty; the stage divisions — refining the self and laying the foundation, refining essence into qi, refining qi into spirit, refining spirit back into emptiness, refining emptiness to join the Dao — were proposed in the Ming dynasty and perfected in the Qing.

title: 入静一直有杂念怎么办
snippet: 自己慢慢磨，这点困难都克服不了，给你传承，你也走不久。
titleEn: What If There Are Always Distracting Thoughts When Entering Stillness?
snippetEn: Slowly grind it yourself; if you cannot overcome even this small difficulty, even with transmission given you, you will not walk far.

title: 什么是丹田？
snippet: 丹田原意是红色的地方，丹取丹朱之意，在丹法产生之前丹田实指下丹田，人如果能内视，就会发现丹田位置就是一团火红色，因此称为“朱红之地”——丹田。后来在内丹法萌芽时期，内丹之道的祖师们提出了上、中、下三丹田的概念。
titleEn: What Is the Dan-Tian?
snippetEn: The original meaning of dan-tian is “the red place”: dan carries the meaning of cinnabar-red; before the dan method arose, dan-tian specifically meant the lower dan-tian. If a person can see inward, they would find the dan-tian location is a mass of fiery red — hence called “the vermilion-red place” — dan-tian. Later, in the budding period of the inner-dan method, the patriarchs of the inner-dan way proposed the concepts of upper, middle and lower dan-tians.

title: 素食者业力无边！
snippet: 经常有一些素食者，到处劝人戒荤腥，以为是做了多么了不起的功德。有的人听我说荤素不忌以营养均衡为主，立刻就说我业力深重不敬神佛小心报应，又说肉食各种不安全不健康容易得癌症云云。
titleEn: Vegetarians Have Boundless Karma!
snippetEn: Often some vegetarians go everywhere urging people to abstain from meat and fish, thinking they have done some tremendously meritorious deed. Some, hearing me say that I do not taboo meat or vegetable but mainly keep nutrition balanced, immediately say my karma is deep and heavy, that I disrespect gods and buddhas, to beware retribution — adding that meat is variously unsafe, unhealthy, cancer-causing, and so on.

title: 为什么要有门户之见？
snippet: 学者们都反对门户之见，我却是支持门户之见的。有门户之见，才能保留自己核心的东西。初学者大多以为天下法门是统一的，佛道一家，三教圆融，门派都是门户之见，却不知道不同体系和不同法门不可混同。道不同不相为谋，说的是就门户之见。
titleEn: Why Should There Be a Sectarian View?
snippetEn: Scholars all oppose the sectarian view; I, however, support it. Only with a sectarian view can one preserve what is core to oneself. Most beginners believe the world’s methods are one — Buddhism and Daoism one family, the three teachings in harmony, and school divisions mere sectarian views — not knowing that different systems and different methods cannot be mixed. “Those whose ways differ cannot plan together” — that is exactly about the sectarian view. In cultivation the sectarian view is a necessity: different roads cannot be mixed; one can only walk on down one road. Tolerance and absorption can mean tolerating others’ methods, each going their own way without interfering with one another — but it should not be an all-nations construction in cultivation.

title: 为什么命越算越薄？
snippet: 算命的结果其实就是一种大概率，例如70%吧，你算完了之后，意识潜意识受到影响，刻意趋向或反向操作，最后达成这个概率的可能性会变成百分之八十。过阵子再算，在百分之八十基础上往下发展的一步，这一步概率累计增加，最后就算死你。
titleEn: Why Does Fate Grow Thinner the More It Is Calculated?
snippetEn: What fortune-telling gives is in fact a kind of high probability — say 70 percent. After you have had it told, your consciousness and subconscious are affected: you deliberately move toward it, or reverse-course against it, and in the end the chance of that probability coming to pass becomes 80 percent. A while later, calculate again — the next step unfolds on the basis of the 80 percent; step by step the probability accumulates, and in the end it simply calculates you to death.

title: 思想有高下之分吗？
snippet: 思想，其实是没有高下之分的，譬如我的道家思想，以修道为标准，就是高一点的境界。若以求财渔色为标准，啥也不是。自以为的高层次高境界，只是以自己的标准产生的错觉，甚至以自己的标准，你也可能啥也不是，只是自以为是。自以为高层次
titleEn: Do Thoughts Have High and Low?
snippetEn: Thoughts, in fact, have no high or low. Take my daoist thought: judged by the standard of cultivating the Dao, it is a somewhat higher realm; judged by seeking wealth and womanizing, it is nothing at all. The high level and high realm you fancy are illusions produced by your own standard — even by your own standard you may be nothing at all, merely self-conceited. He who fancies himself high-level, high-realm and wears a whole body of superiority is in reality just a %￥#%.

title: 修丹法为什么脾气大？
snippet: 神炁修得越高，对情绪的影响会越严重，你的炁与神是挂钩的，神动炁必动，神强了，神动一点就是天崩星坼，炁强了，炁动一点就是地动山摇。就算你修的好一些，如果道心不足，不能很好把握自己的情绪，神气互相影响，脾气就会很差。
titleEn: Why Does Dan Practice Give a Hot Temper?
snippetEn: The higher spirit and qi are cultivated, the more severe their influence on the emotions. Your qi and spirit are linked: when the spirit moves, the qi must move. With the spirit grown strong, a slight stir of the spirit is the sky collapsing and stars splitting apart; with the qi grown strong, a slight stir of the qi is the earth quaking and mountains shaking. Even if you practice somewhat well, if the dao-heart is insufficient and you cannot well govern your emotions, spirit and qi affecting each other, the temper will be very bad.

title: 什么是死玄关和活玄关
snippet: 有人问到这个问题，我就说一说。死玄关和活玄关应该是清朝丹道西派的说法，把传统道家凝神入气穴叫做死玄关，把介于佛道之间的凝神不入窍叫做活玄关，就是所谓凝神身外虚空。鼻外虚空、脐外虚空，都是西派常用。其实就难度而言，凝神虚空
titleEn: What Are the Dead Gate of Mystery and the Living Gate of Mystery?
snippetEn: Someone asked this question, so I will speak of it. The dead gate of mystery and the living gate of mystery should be terms of the Western school of dan-dao in the Qing dynasty: the traditional daoist congealing spirit into the qi-cavern they called the dead gate of mystery, and the congealing spirit without entering the cavity, between Buddhism and Daoism, they called the living gate of mystery — the so-called congealing spirit into the void outside the body. The void outside the nose, the void outside the navel — all commonly used by the Western school.

title: 《信仰的真相》
snippet: 神有两种：一种由万民心念凭空造出，另一种由残存的魂魄阴神受香火而成。神力、神职皆由信徒赋予；香火念力如法界货币，神人互役，不得自由。
titleEn: 《The Truth of Faith》
snippetEn: There are two kinds of gods: one conjured from the collective minds of the multitude, the other a surviving remnant soul or yin-spirit fed by incense-fire. Power and office alike are granted by believers; incense-fire thought-power is the currency of the dharma-realm. God and man enslave each other — neither is free.

title: 《法界的真相》
snippet: 宗教法界是鬼神在灵界中半封闭的地盘，由无数信徒的信念构成。教徒在其中充当电池与过滤器；神与法界一体不二，一荣俱荣，一损俱损。
titleEn: 《The Truth of the Dharma-Realm》
snippetEn: A religious dharma-realm is a half-enclosed territory of gods and ghosts within the spirit world, built from the faith of countless believers. Adherents serve there as batteries and filters; god and dharma-realm are one and indivisible — honor shared, ruin shared.

title: 《轮回的真相》
snippet: 轮回并非宇宙本来法则，而是某些宗教以香火念力建立的残缺系统。所谓前世记忆，多为残魂碎魄与信息碎片；自主择胎，方是真正的转世。
titleEn: 《The Truth of Reincarnation》
snippetEn: Reincarnation is no native law of the universe, but a crippled system certain religions built from incense-fire thought-power. So-called past-life memories are mostly remnant souls and information fragments; choosing one's own womb is the true rebirth.

title: 《神道的真相》
snippet: 神道与自力是修行的两条路径。祖先神道、封神法、宗教功德、附庸神明祖师，诸般神道法门，归根结底皆离不开香火：香火有毒，断绝道途。
titleEn: 《The Truth of Divinity》
snippetEn: The divine way and self-power are the two roads of cultivation. Ancestral divine way, enfeoffment methods, religious merit, leaning on gods and ancestors — all divine-way methods come down to incense-fire: incense-fire is poison, and severs the path.

title: 《附体的真相》
snippet: 凡外来精神进入人身或傍随左右施加影响，皆属广义附体。附体的目的、媒介、方式、表现与克制方法，一一道来。
titleEn: 《The Truth of Possession》
snippetEn: Any external spirit that enters one's body or keeps at one's side to exert influence counts, broadly, as possession. Its purposes, media, methods, signs, and counters — all told in this piece.

title: 《下种的真相》
snippet: 下种修炼，即附庸神明祖师仙佛，以自身神炁养大他人所下之种。种子有鬼神种子与祖师种子之别：免费的最贵，白给的好处越多，他们要的越多。
titleEn: 《The Truth of Seeding》
snippetEn: Seeding means leaning on gods, ancestors, immortals, and Buddhas, feeding the seed another has planted with one's own spirit-qi. Ghost-god seeds and ancestor seeds differ: the free is the dearest — the more given gratis, the more they want.

title: 《劝善的真相》
snippet: 宗教劝善多以恐吓利诱为手段，以利益观代替道德观，令人失却淳朴。建立在威胁利诱之上的善，只是权宜之计。
titleEn: 《The Truth of Preaching Good》
snippetEn: Religious preaching of good works mostly by threat and bribe, replacing the sense of right and wrong with the sense of profit. Good built on threat and lure is only an expedient.

title: 《逃名的秘密》
snippet: 人出名之后，众人心念会在身周聚成类似香火的气场，能壮运亦能败运。自力修道人当隐者逃名，不沾香火。
titleEn: 《The Secret of Avoiding Fame》
snippetEn: Once a person is famous, the crowd's thoughts gather around him into an incense-fire-like field, able to strengthen fortune and to ruin it. The self-power cultivator should hide, avoid fame, and touch no incense-fire.

title: 《法术的秘密》
snippet: 法术的原理归根结底归于神炁：或以内神沟通外神，四两拨千斤；或以神道沟通鬼神、借力施术。法术亦有神道与自力之别。
titleEn: 《The Secret of Spells》
snippetEn: The principle of spells comes down in the end to spirit-qi: the inner spirit communing with the outer spirit, four ounces shifting a thousand catties — or divine-way links borrowing the power of ghosts and gods. Spells too divide into divine way and self-power.

title: 《符箓的秘密》
snippet: 符箓可说是局限在纸上的法术。通神符借神灵之力封存于纸，自力符以自身精气神驻留纸上；其步骤与原理，和造神、文字相去不远。
titleEn: 《The Secret of Talismans》
snippetEn: A talisman may be called a spell confined to paper. Spirit-communication talismans seal deity-power into the paper; self-power talismans lodge one's own essence-qi-spirit there. The steps and principles are near kin to god-making and to writing itself.

title: 《法器的秘密》
snippet: 法器是固化的符箓。材料、养法、神道与自力之别，以及人器互染、养器亦养人的道理，皆在本篇。
titleEn: 《The Secret of Artifacts》
snippetEn: A dharma artifact is a solidified talisman. Materials, raising methods, the divine-way and self-power kinds, and the mutual dyeing of person and artifact — raising the artifact, and raising the person too — all in this piece.

title: 《古往今来的体系》
snippet: 修炼分炼神、炼形、培养道心三大方面；法门有存思、存神、精思、导引、服食、咒音、内丹、采炁等；依得炁来源又分内求与外求，依力量归属再分自力与它力。
titleEn: 《The Systems of Past and Present》
snippetEn: Cultivation divides into refining the spirit, refining the form and nurturing the dao-heart; methods include cunsi, cunshen, jingsi, daoyin, fushi, incantation tones, inner alchemy and qi-gathering; by qi-source, inner-seeking and outer-seeking; by power, self-power and other-power.

title: 《神道法》
snippet: 神道分自力与它力：祖先神道与三不朽、祖师神道，封神法香火神道，传教积功受封神官，附庸神明祖师壮大种子。香火有毒，断绝道途。
titleEn: 《Shendao — the Way of Gods》
snippetEn: The divine way divides into self-power and other-power: the ancestral divine way and the Three Imperishables, the patriarchal way, the enfeoffing rite of the incense-fire divine way, spreading religion to be enfeoffed a divine official, and vassal gods or patriarchs to swell the seed. Incense-fire is poison — it severs the path.

title: 《通神》
snippet: 通神即与神相通，一门古老秘技：神有所择，人有所学；神明有等级、血脉有亲疏；四途分流——通神者、侍神者、神使、密修者。
titleEn: 《Tongshen》
snippetEn: Tongshen is communication with the gods, an ancient secret art: the gods choose, people learn; gods have ranks, bloodlines have kinship and distance; four paths branch — the communicant, the serving attendant, the divine envoy, the hidden cultivator.

title: 《驻颜术》
snippet: 古往今来，多少人追求容颜不老？却苦求无果？——驻颜术原文与作用五项。
titleEn: 《Zhuyan — Preserving the Countenance》
snippetEn: Down the ages, how many have sought a face that never ages, and sought in vain? — The Zhuyan text and its five effects.

title: 《男子房中术》
snippet: 鏖战之法为门中主法，另有还阳补虚、止遗精法、养阳固本三项养生配套；并辨养阳与壮阳之别。
titleEn: 《Aozhan — the Fierce Rite》
snippetEn: The fierce rite is the main method of the gate, with three supporting nourishing-life arts — restoring yang and tonifying deficiency, stopping nocturnal loss, and nourishing yang to firm the root — and a distinction drawn between nourishing yang and strengthening yang.

title: 《为什么修炼这种事情，自古以来普罗大众绝大部分不知道？》
snippet: 阶级、变故、限制、古来有成者——四重门槛叠在一起，便足够抹杀九成七的求道之人。
titleEn: 《Why has the mass of ordinary people never known of cultivation since ancient times?》
snippetEn: This matter has never been easily told since ancient times — for a time I knew not where to start, for it contains far too much. So let us come to know it one piece at a time.

title: 《论人求道杂谈》
snippet: 求道之难，不在虔诚与资质，而在「是人家挑人」。隐与秘、师与徒、考核与人心，一篇说尽。
titleEn: 《Miscellany on People Seeking the Way》
snippetEn: Since ancient times the seekers of the Way have been many and the attainers few — and within it there is very much.

title: 《日常养生修炼功法（问答）》
snippet: 广播体操、八部金刚功、八段锦、五禽戏——大众最常见的基础养生功法，就在眼前。
titleEn: 《Daily Nourishing and Cultivation Practices (Q&A)》
snippetEn: The following is health-nourishing content gathered online; the effects are not empirically verified.

title: 《何为修炼？它们的目的是什么？》
snippet: 修巫、修真、修仙、修佛，最终目的都是长生；打坐六问，与「没有传承别自己瞎折腾」。
titleEn: 《What Is Cultivation? What Is Its Aim? (Xiuzhen, Xiuxian and Such Terms)》
snippetEn: Whether wu-cultivation, true-cultivation, immortal-cultivation, buddha-cultivation and so on, the final aim is long life; the schools may differ, but the beautiful goal is to live long.

title: 《修炼之中师父、老师教什么？》
snippet: 师父与老师之别；真法、火候、心性、经验四教；明师难得，明师难得，明师难得。
titleEn: 《What Do Master and Teacher Teach in Cultivation?》
snippetEn: A master and a teacher are different; let us speak of them separately.

title: 《道友基本有哪些不问？》
snippet: 不问寿、不问师、不问修为——不查户口，是礼貌，也是分寸。
titleEn: 《What Are the Things One Basically Does Not Ask Fellow Cultivators?》
snippetEn: No need to say much — but the basic few points exist.

title: 《为什么要有门户之见？》
snippet: 各家有各家的体系与言语，门户之见既是自家的安全保证，也是对别人的安全保证。
titleEn: 《Why Must There Be Sectarian Exclusivity?》
snippetEn: Through the ages there has always been exclusivity between houses; but who knows when it began — gradually it spread that people should cast off exclusivity and merge all into one, blah blah blah. Many have surely seen this on TV and in film; then so-and-so defeated something, or became the guide of some whole new place, and slowly countless aspiring cultivators raised all sorts of voices: for instance, that your things should be taken out and shared with everyone, and words of that kind…

title: 《要不要劝人修炼？》
snippet: 用不着、没必要——不向往的人劝之无益，机缘与考核先筛掉了绝大多数人。
titleEn: 《Should One Urge Others to Cultivate?》
snippetEn: No need — none necessary.

title: 《飞升、高低维等问题》
snippet: 这个世界就是最好的；虚幻法界、升维之说与香火之辩，以及「身死道消」的老话。
titleEn: 《Ascension, Higher and Lower Dimensions, and Other Questions》
snippetEn: A crowd out there talks of ascension, of higher dimensions, of lower dimensions — piles of words and theories, with the settled air that ascending to a higher dimension is the supreme thing, the glory, the future, and so on.

title: 《炼形概论》
snippet: 炼形非炼体：后天炼行与先天炼形之别，返年轻、孩婴、先天之体、人仙之体。
titleEn: 《On Refining the Form: An Introduction》
snippetEn: At the mention of form-refining, many think of body-training and take them for the same thing — in fact it is not so.

title: 《练形2》
snippet: 收敛、金玉、罡煞、太阴、咒音、存思、导引——炼形诸名相与先后天之别。
titleEn: 《Form-Refining 2》
snippetEn: Yesterday's article roughly covered form-refining; today's covers some of the terms that appear — descriptive, so to speak.

title: 《修行吃什么（一）》
snippet: 饮食补消耗是一整套体系：服食、阶段、目的，皆非一句吃素或辟谷可以概括。
titleEn: 《What Cultivators Eat (One)》
snippetEn: At the mention of eating, most in cultivation instinctively give different answers out of rumor, religion and self-understanding: vegetarianism, grain-avoidance, and so on.

title: 《修行吃什么（二）》
snippet: 练功到一定地步饭量反而增加；吃素吃肉的缘由与练形炼神之别，全凭各自。
titleEn: 《What Cultivators Eat (Two)》
snippetEn: What to eat — that is the question.

title: 《修炼之中，用不用禁色？》
snippet: 节欲胜于禁欲，禁欲胜于纵欲——纯阳之体、漏丹与「中华憋精」，六条说清。
titleEn: 《In Cultivation, Does One Abstain from Sex?》
snippetEn: No — but moderation is needed; excess is not allowed.

title: 《剑仙相关浅谈》
snippet: 剑仙是笼统的大概念：剑仙法、剑器、剑侠、丹剑四脉，以及四则剑仙杂谈。
titleEn: 《A Brief Talk on Sword Immortals》
snippetEn: At the mention of sword immortals, the picture most minds conjure on their own is roughly: righting wrongs, riding swords in flight, spirit-swords at their side, taking heads from a thousand li away, and so on.

title: 《导引法是旁门左道么？》
snippet: 丹道盛行以前，存思、导引、炼气、服气皆为道家正统修法；导引另有专门的入道法。
titleEn: 《Is Daoyin a Heterodox Side-Path?》
snippetEn: Item 4 of another piece on basic cognition of cultivation, "What Cultivation Roughly Contains," mentioned some of this.

title: 《使用功能的代价后果》
snippet: 天生与后得的神通，用过度则虚弱、刺痛乃至寿命锐减——宗门为何要封禁。
titleEn: 《The Costs and Consequences of Using Powers》
snippetEn: Many are muddled about this matter of powers — but under another name everyone catches on: the costs and consequences of using spirit-powers.

title: 《修行与神通》
snippet: 神通是长生路上的副产品：自力、外物、鬼神诸途，与「这种东西不要奢望」。
titleEn: 《Cultivation and Spirit-Powers》
snippetEn: At the mention of cultivation, many instinctively want to confirm whether you have spirit-powers — the heavenly eye, clairvoyance and such — as if only these were the true way.

title: 《道家、巫家、修炼为什么衰落了？》
snippet: 并非衰落，只是外界不知：巫教变故、道家未断，隐传秘传向来是人家挑人。
titleEn: 《Why Have the Dao House, the Wu House and Cultivation Declined?》
snippetEn: About "decline" — in fact it is not so; it is only that the ordinary outside world does not know.

title: 《可以免费教我修道么？我真的一心向道，求求你了！！！》
snippet: 孔子收腊肉、五斗米教收五斗米——自古真想学东西，要钱也要态度，我不欠你什么。
titleEn: 《Can You Teach Me the Way for Free? I Am Truly Wholehearted — Please!!!》
snippetEn: No — because I owe you nothing.

title: 《好好修炼，什么时候能够成仙？》
snippet: 修炼没有包票：也许几月起色，也许一辈子养生长乐，也许一辈子都不会成功。
titleEn: 《Cultivating Well — When Will One Become an Immortal?》
snippetEn: Cultivation has no guarantee, no hundred percent. Never mind that ordinary people basically have no hope of stepping onto the true road of cultivation; even stepping on it, it depends on the completeness of everything.

title: 《群主你为什么说话那么难听？》
snippet: 言语是否伤人，取决于听的人的经历；难听与否，本身就是一层筛选。
titleEn: 《Group Owner, Why Do You Speak So Harshly?》
snippetEn: A: whether a person's words hurt another depends on the listener's experience.

title: 《末法时代来了？》
snippet: 神佛靠香火而活，香火本质是人的心念；科技与虚拟现实兴起，才是它们着急的缘由。
titleEn: 《Has the Dharma-Ending Age Arrived?》
snippetEn: Many people run into my group and, at the drop of a hat, start on about the Dharma-Ending Age, blah blah blah; I ask how they know, and they begin: "That is what everyone says, that is how it is passed around." Then I know: this is a passerby with no independent thought.

title: 《无病呻吟》
snippet: 得传承数年后的一篇随笔：关于传承、家庭、生死、婚姻与传道，五处透彻。
titleEn: 《Aimless Moaning》
snippetEn: It has been a long time since I published a new article — laziness, plus questions answered and talked through in the group, so nothing got written; today happens to be the Spring Festival of Year 26, the New Year approaching, so let me write a little of these years' reflections.
